title: Building an AI App — Treat the Product as a Decision System
key_insight: Define which decisions are advisory, automatically executed, or human-approved. Store enough evidence to explain and reverse important actions.
body:
## Treat the Product as a Decision System

Model output changes what a user sees or what software does next. That makes thresholds, overrides, and accountability part of the design.

Define which decisions are advisory, automatically executed, or human-approved. Store enough evidence to explain and reverse important actions.

Measure task completion and harm, not merely messages sent. A fluent model can increase engagement while making the real job worse.
common_mistakes: Adding a chat box automatically creates user value.
Fluent output proves the user task succeeded.
A production app needs no fallback path.
mini_exercise: Draw “Treat the Product as a Decision System” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: A useful AI app connects a clear user job to context, model calls, validation, feedback, and fallback behavior.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Treat the Product as a Decision System” to explain Building an AI App plainly.
